text:
alice_support: Customer reports intermittent 502s for hosted API over the last 20m. Happening across regions, mostly during heavy auth rotations. Customer says it started after they rotated keys. sample: trace=gc1-ff12-9a

alex_sre: Can you paste a trace id + customer request headers? Also which model/route?

alice_support: route: /v1/generate, model: redwood/fast-xxl, trace: gc1-ff12-9a. Headers look normal but we see repeated 401 -> retry loop on our side. Short curl they ran:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

maya_prod: Looking at global ingress metrics: sudden spike in auth validation latency ~45s, envoy upstream_rq_5xx increased from 0.2% to 6% in 2m. Also @ben_edge logs show many upstream host ejections (circuit_breaker).

ben_edge: Pasted a snippet from edge logs:
```
[2026-03-16T12:27:33Z] upstream response code: 502, upstream host ejected: true, reason="response_code" trace=gc1-ff12-9a
[2026-03-16T12:27:34Z] auth-validate failed: 401, retrying, queue_len=128
[2026-03-16T12:27:34Z] envoy: host ejected due to consecutive 5xx (count=5)
```

alex_sre: Sounds like an auth-validation thundering herd causing upstream overload -> hosts ejected -> 502 cascade. Might be two interacting limits: auth service concurrency + envoy circuit-breaker thresholds. Did deploy-bot run anything? @ci-deploy-bot any recent rolls?

ci-deploy-bot: deploy:auth-service v2.14.1 rolled 2026-03-16T12:25:50Z by ci/pipeline #4521 (automatic key-rotate job). No other infra rolls in window. :information_source:

alice_support: Customer says they triggered a large key rotation and retried clients aggressively. They also set short token TTL.

maya_prod: Quick triage checklist:
- Check envoy cluster.ejected_hosts count (confirmed rising)
- Inspect auth-service pod CPU / 429/5xx (auth shows CPU spike and 429s)
- Verify connection pool exhaustion on ingress (netstat shows many TIME_WAIT)
- Confirm retry budget causing duplicate upstreams

ben_edge: Mitigation options I can do now:
- temporarily increase envoy circuit_breaker max_connections and max_pending_requests for auth cluster (low risk)
- route auth traffic to healthy fallback pool in us-west (requires quick route override)
- increase auth cache TTL for tokens from 30s -> 300s to reduce validation calls (needs prod-config change)

alex_sre: Do not increase retries. We should reduce retries and front-door duplication. I'll open an emergency canary: bump circuit_breaker thresholds + add a short token-cache window (in-memory) to ingress edge for 10m as stopgap. Ben, can you apply overrides?

ben_edge: On it. Applying cb override to auth cluster and enabling short LRU token cache on edge (config id: edge-cache-ephemeral-20260316). Will monitor.

alice_support: Customer patched clients to back off as well. They're seeing fewer errors. Thanks.

ben_edge: After override: upstream_5xx back down to ~0.6%, ejected_hosts dropping. auth validation calls down ~85%. Removing override in 30m after verifying stability.

maya_prod: Postmortem action items
- (P1) Add circuit breaker dynamic scaling to avoid eager ejections during auth bursts
- (P2) Add short token-cache on edge by default for ephemeral tokens (configurable TTL)
- (P2) Add a dashboard that correlates auth 429/5xx with envoy ejection events and request retry budget usage
- (P3) Docs: best-practice for customers rotating keys (recommended backoff and staged rollouts)

alice_support: Noted. Customer is stable for now, will follow up if they see recurrence. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
